test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 11 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: If a 1768 m long train crosses a pole in 68 seconds, then find the time (in seconds) taken by the train to cross a 338 m long platform.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Speed of train = 1768 ÷ 68 = 26 m/s.

Total distance to cross platform = Train length + Platform length = 1768 + 338 = 2106 m.

Time taken = Total Distance ÷ Speed = 2106 ÷ 26 = 81 seconds.

**∴ The correct answer is 81.**
